naming.rule: A part is called by its codename. An alias is an edition label; '#' means the alias is retired and maps to no part.
naming.notes: Ingot is not the main part. Zingma takes Lite, Sonar takes Plus (official DeepSeek Harness), Zenix CC takes Ultra.
